Référence 5921813
|
Créé le 10 août 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée indéterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Logiciel - Software
Nombre d'années d'expérience :
Minimum 3 ans d'expérience
Description de la fonction
Translating data intoactionable insights, reportswhile contributing to the continuous improvement of data-driven decision-making. This job is waiting for you!
Ready to turn data into real business impact?
Join an international technology company in Brussels and help transform complex data into meaningful insights that support smarter business decisions.
Our partner, an
innovative and growing technology company
, is looking for a
Data Analyst
to join its team and play a key role in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting data across the organization.
Data & Business Analyst - Role & Responsibilities
Collect, clean, and analyze data from multiple
internal and external sources
to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities.
Develop and maintain
dashboards, reports, and data visualizations
to support business and operational decisions.
Translate business requirements into meaningful
data analyses, KPIs, and performance indicators
.
Work with stakeholders across different departments to understand their needs and provide
data-driven recommendations
.
Perform ad hoc analyses and investigate data discrepancies to identify root causes and improvement opportunities.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and accuracy across reporting and analytical processes.
Contribute to the optimization of data processes, reporting automation, and the continuous improvement of the company's
data-driven culture
.
Profil
Data & Business Analyst - Profile & Requirements
2 to 8 years of experience as a
Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or in a similar data-focused role
.
Strong proficiency in
SQL
and experience working with large and complex datasets.
Hands-on experience with
Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization tools
.
Good understanding of data analysis, reporting, KPIs, and data visualization principles.
Experience with
Python
for data analysis is a strong plus.
Familiarity with databases, data warehouses, and ETL processes is an advantage.
Analytical and structured mindset, with strong attention to detail and a natural curiosity for understanding data.
Able to translate complex data into
clear and actionable insights
for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Fluent in English and Dutch
Compétences linguistiques
Néérlandais (atout)
Comprendre : Elémentaire (A)
Écrire : Elémentaire (A)
Lire : Elémentaire (A)
Parler : Elémentaire (A)
Avantages du poste
Data & Business Analyst - Offer & Benefits
Join an
international tech company
where data plays an increasingly important role in business decisions.
Work on diverse projects with access to
large and meaningful datasets
.
Opportunity to collaborate closely with both technical and business teams.
Training and development opportunities to strengthen your expertise in
data analytics, visualization, and BI
.
Collaborative and dynamic environment encouraging autonomy and initiative.
Competitive salary package with attractive extralegal benefits.
Opportunity to contribute directly to the development of a
stronger data-driven culture and smarter business processes
.
Benefits
Meal Vouchers
Mobility Budget

Company phone & subscription

Bonus
